metadata.planning_basis: The five findings converge on one Online request/session pipeline: stcontrolRequestTracker admission atomicity, managed-to-independent durable promotion, admin/user handoff exclusivity, ordinary-request persistence, and browser heartbeat entry wiring all touch the same state machine or its direct route/frontend entrypoints. Keep src/stcontrol.js, src/endpoints/stcontrol.js, public/scripts/user*.js, and the related node tests under one execution group so the same agent can land the state-shape changes and regressions without cross-group file conflicts.
downstream_serial_dependencies: batch-4/FIX-DATA-FAULT-RELEASE must stay after batch-1 because it extends the same Sillytarven-online/src/stcontrol.js and Sillytarven-online/src/endpoints/stcontrol.js gate/release contract.

batch-4/FIX-DATA-FAULT-RELEASE must also stay after batch-2 because FIX-R14-PASSWORD-REMOVAL changes the same Sillytarven-online/src/endpoints/stcontrol.js endpoint surface that batch 4 reuses for fenced remove and release wiring.
